name: RUSCUAV
description: RUSCUAV is a benchmark for low-altitude urban cargo-UAV navigation that scores missions by semantic mission acceptability as well as by target-reaching success. The ruscuav-benchmark package provides validated world files, a Gymnasium environment, the risk-cost A* planners and PPO policies of the paper, evaluation protocols with fixed missions, scoring of any method's trajectories, the paper's statistics, and a builder of worlds from OpenStreetMap data. The archived evaluations, trained weights and paper-ready tables are in the Zenodo record; processed real-GIS worlds are not in the repository (the Vienna world of the paper and the Berlin world of the SoftwareX article's Example 2 are published apart under the ODbL).
softwareRequirements: OSMnx >= 2.0, GeoPandas >= 1.0, Shapely >= 2.0, Rasterio >= 1.3, PyProj >= 3.6 (extra gis)
